text:
sam: Quick alignment request — console + SDKs should stop inferring user-visible categories from HTTP status alone.
anya: +1. 429/503 are overloaded right now. UX shows wrong badges.
sam: Proposal: add a small stable enum field `error_kind` in the response envelope and a short `user_message`. Keep HTTP codes for infra semantics.
jeff: Suggested enum values: QUOTA_EXCEEDED, THROTTLE_TRANSIENT, ROUTE_DEGRADED, MODEL_NOT_LOADED, BAD_REQUEST.
maria: Product wants three badges: rate/quota, transient/retry, needs-action. Map enum -> badge.
priya: Draft mapping: QUOTA_EXCEEDED -> rate/quota; THROTTLE_TRANSIENT -> transient/retry; ROUTE_DEGRADED -> transient/retry; MODEL_NOT_LOADED -> needs-action; BAD_REQUEST -> needs-action. Telemetry tag: error.kind.
sam: Also add `fallback_used` and `fallback_variant` so console can explain degraded outputs. Keep `internal_details` out of user surface.
anya: SDK contract: if error_kind is THROTTLE_TRANSIENT or ROUTE_DEGRADED, show retry guidance and honor `retry_after` if present; do NOT auto-retry terminal errors.
deploy-bot: feature-flag `error-taxonomy-v1` created by @sam; rollout planned canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
jeff: I'll open the schema PR and add a CI validator to check responses against the enum during rollout.
priya: I'll draft telemetry sampling and dashboard migration to `error.kind`.
maria: I'll own console badge mapping and the rollout banner copy.
sam: Action items: PR schema + console updates + SDK changes + telemetry sampling. Sync next week after canary. :thumbsup:
